title: Communication Bias in Large Language Models: A Regulatory Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: The paper is a regulatory and conceptual review that evaluates bias by synthesizing existing literature on LLM political leanings. It proposes measuring this bias through benchmark datasets (e.g., GermanPartiesQA) to assess model alignment with specific political party positions, and through prompt experiments to detect sycophancy and analyze how outputs shift based on user prompts.
